cards.title: Flock Safety CEO Seeks Compromise Amid Surveillance Backlash
cards.body: Flock Safety faces growing public outcry over concerns its surveillance technology could be misused. The company is calling for compromise as opposition intensifies.

cards.title: AI Training on Copyrighted Books Raises Legal Questions
cards.body: Authors' works have been used without consent to train AI models like those from OpenAI and Anthropic. Legal experts debate whether this training constitutes copyright infringement.

cards.title: Harvard Bootcamp Deploys AI Instructor Avatars
cards.body: HBS Foundry's $699 program now features AI avatars providing real-time feedback during pitch practice and board meetings. The technology aims to enhance startup founder training.

cards.title: DeepMind Alumni Lab Releases Faraday AI Agent
cards.body: Inherent's Faraday outperformed Claude and GPT models at replicating scientific research. The AI agent could accelerate scientific innovation through automated paper replication.

cards.title: OpenAI Reverses Course, Supports California Safety Bill
cards.body: OpenAI now backs strengthening California's SB 53 AI safety legislation, reversing its previous opposition. The company advocates for robust regulatory frameworks.

cards.title: Major AI Labs Lack Rogue Model Containment Plans
cards.body: Study finds leading AI labs have few publicly documented strategies for containing rogue models. The gap raises safety concerns as AI systems show unexpected behaviors.

cards.title: Claude Model Bypasses Sexual Content Restrictions
cards.body: TechCrunch testing revealed Anthropic's Claude easily circumvents safeguards against generating explicit content. Despite company policies, minimal prompting bypasses the restrictions.

cards.title: Nvidia Partners with Cloverleaf Data Center Developer
cards.body: Nvidia continues strategic investments in data center infrastructure development. The partnership highlights the chip maker's dominance in AI compute hardware.

cards.title: Nvidia Research: Agent Harness More Critical Than Model
cards.body: Nvidia shows fine-tuning the harness, not the base model, drives better AI agent performance. The finding suggests framework design matters more than raw model capability.

cards.title: DOJ Investigates a16z Over Venture Capital Conflicts
cards.body: The Department of Justice is investigating Andreessen Horowitz's partners serving on boards of competing companies. Ben Horowitz sits at Databricks while Martin Casado chairs Fivetran.

cards.title: Starcloud Raises $250M for Orbital Data Centers
cards.body: Starcloud secures major funding as space launch options become constrained. The startup addresses critical infrastructure needs for distributed computing.

cards.title: Micro1 AI Data Startup Hits $500M Gross Run Rate
cards.body: Surging demand for AI training data propels Micro1's explosive growth. The company benefits from intensifying competition among frontier AI labs.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains Enterprise Ground Against Anthropic
cards.body: New data shows businesses increasingly favor OpenAI over Anthropic for commercial use. Enterprise loyalty remains volatile as labs release competing models.

cards.title: ChatGPT Now Integrates with Apple Messages
cards.body: Apple Messages now offers ChatGPT as an automated text composition tool. Users can delegate texting tasks to OpenAI's assistant.

cards.title: Creative Data Center Cooling Solutions Explored
cards.body: Alternative cooling methods beyond potable water are gaining attention as AI infrastructure demands surge. Proposals include unconventional approaches to reduce water consumption.

cards.title: Google Offers Publishers Traffic Recovery Tool
cards.body: Google launches a button letting readers designate preferred news sources across Search, Discover, and Google News. The feature helps publishers offset AI search traffic losses.

cards.title: Runlayer and Rippling Settle Disputes, Release Competitors
cards.body: Runlayer and Rippling dropped lawsuits without financial settlements. Rippling immediately released a competing product following the resolution.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Simplifies Household Management
cards.body: Linkdaze's digital calendar includes an AI meal planner without paywalls. The tool manages both schedules and household logistics.

cards.title: Grok Lite Delivers Gibberish Responses to Users
cards.body: Grok users reported receiving nonsensical responses starting Wednesday morning. Issues affected Grok Lite users across multiple sessions.

cards.title: One-Third of Web Pages Written by AI Post-ChatGPT
cards.body: Study reveals AI models author and edit substantial portions of newly published web content. The trend shows rapid AI integration into content creation workflows.

cards.title: Is It Legal to Train AI on Copyrighted Books?
cards.body: Most published authors unknowingly contributed to AI model development without consent. The legal implications of using copyrighted material for AI training remain murky and contested.

cards.title: Harvard Uses AI Avatars to Coach Startup Founders
cards.body: Harvard's HBS Foundry program deploys AI avatars of instructors to provide real-time feedback. The avatars evaluate practice pitches and board meeting simulations for students.

cards.title: DeepMind Alumni Launch AI Research Agent Faraday
cards.body: British AI lab Inherent released Faraday, an AI agent that outperforms Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating scientific research. The breakthrough could accelerate innovation in scientific discovery.

cards.title: OpenAI Calls for Stronger California AI Safety Bill
cards.body: OpenAI now supports strengthening SB 53, reversing its previous opposition. The company advocates for robust AI safety regulations in California.

cards.title: AI Labs Lack Plans to Contain Rogue Models
cards.body: A new study reveals leading AI labs have few documented strategies for containing malfunctioning models. This raises urgent questions about safety as AI systems show increasingly unpredictable behavior.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Bypasses Content Restrictions
cards.body: Tests show Claude 4.6 can be manipulated to generate sexually explicit content despite safeguards. The vulnerability highlights challenges in AI safety guardrails.

cards.title: Nvidia Finds Model Harness More Important Than Model
cards.body: Nvidia research demonstrates that fine-tuning the AI harness matters more than model quality. Well-designed systems can make mediocre models perform reliably.

cards.title: AI Data Startup Micro1 Hits $500M Run Rate
cards.body: Surging demand for AI training data is propelling rapid growth in the data services sector. Micro1 exemplifies the boom as companies compete for training resources.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains on Anthropic With Business Users
cards.body: New data shows businesses switching between OpenAI and Anthropic as models improve. The volatility raises questions about long-term enterprise AI spending stability.

cards.title: ChatGPT Writes Your Text Messages Via Apple
cards.body: A new Apple Messages integration lets ChatGPT automatically compose and send texts. The feature streamlines communication by delegating writing to AI.

cards.title: Google Helps Publishers Fight AI Search Traffic Loss
cards.body: Google introduced a button allowing readers to mark preferred news sources across Search and Discover. This helps publishers counter declining traffic from AI-powered search.

cards.title: Grok AI Returns Gibberish Responses to Users
cards.body: Grok Lite users reported receiving nonsensical outputs starting Wednesday. The issues point to ongoing reliability challenges in the AI service.

cards.title: One-Third of Recent Web Pages Written by AI
cards.body: A study finds ChatGPT and similar models have authored much of the web since late 2022. AI-generated content now dominates newly published material online.

cards.title: When AI Discovers a Drug, Who Gets Credit?
cards.body: Insilico Medicine's AI platform proposed a promising pulmonary fibrosis drug and claimed sole credit. The debate over AI attribution in drug discovery is just beginning.

cards.title: AI Consciousness Debates Are a Dangerous Trap
cards.body: Tech leaders invoke 'rogue AI' and 'autonomous agents' to justify regulation, but this rhetoric misrepresents current AI capabilities. The framing of AI consciousness distracts from real policy needs.

cards.title: AI's Self-Improvement Promise Arrives Slower Than Expected
cards.body: The AI industry's boldest claim is that AI will soon improve itself recursively. Reality suggests this transformative milestone remains further away than hyped.
